Financial definitions The indicators below are not defined by IFRS and may not be comparable to those used by other companies. [#107](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264324010-107)

Organic growth in the Group's revenue is calculated excluding:  the impacts of changes in the scope of consolidation of "major acquisitions" and "major disposals." [#108](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264324010-108)

Adjusted EBITDA is defined as adjusted EBIT before depreciation and amortization, net of the portion of grants transferred to income. [#109](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264324010-109)
Adjusted EBITDA margin is defined as adjusted EBITDA divided by revenue. [#110](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264324010-110)

Adjusted EBIT is defined as net income (loss) before net financial income (loss), income tax, share in net income of equity accounted companies, amortization of intangible assets recognized in a business combination, goodwill impairment losses, other operating income and expense, miscellaneous financial items (bank fees recognized in operating income) and IFRS 2 expenses (share-based payments). [#111](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264324010-111)
Adjusted EBIT margin is defined as adjusted EBIT divided by revenue. [#112](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264324010-112)

Headline net income corresponds to net income or loss excluding extraordinary items which, due to their type and unusual nature, cannot be considered as intrinsic to the Group's current performance. [#113](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_NONSEC000264324010-113)
